extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners, patent attorneys/agents, applicants, and other patent practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: The Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) is the USPTO's authoritative compendium of patent examination policies, procedures, and substantive guidance across the full range of U.S. patent practice. This page is the MPEP table-of-contents/entry hub linking to chapters, appendices, and supplemental materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) (9th Edition, Rev. 01.2024)
rubrics_metrics.description: The current MPEP (9th Edition, Rev. 01.2024), published November 2024, is up-to-date as of January 31, 2024. Revision indicators [R-01.2024] identify sections revised in the current MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the overarching canonical source of USPTO patent examining policies and procedures. Users should consult the specific chapter(s) for detailed standards and procedures; revised sections are flagged with [R-01.2024].

rubrics_metrics.name: Updates Since Current MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing of documents and changes to USPTO patent examining policies and procedures that occurred after January 31, 2024 and are under consideration for future inclusion in the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes links to subsequent publications and notices that supersede portions of the current MPEP; consult this list for post-publication changes (listing current as of July 18, 2025 on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable MPEP (eMPEP)
rubrics_metrics.description: A searchable version of the MPEP with help resources (user manual and quick reference guide) for search features (default operators, proximity searches, wild cards) and navigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use eMPEP for full-text searching across the MPEP; see provided user manual/quick reference for effective searching techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change Summary
rubrics_metrics.description: A summary explaining the changes made in the current MPEP revision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult for a concise explanation of what was revised in the current edition and where to find those revisions in the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title Page / Foreword / Introduction / Table of Contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Front matter for the MPEP including title page, foreword, introduction, and table of contents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides context, scope, and organization for the manual; useful for citation and orientation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 100 - Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and procedures relating to secrecy orders, access restrictions, national security considerations, and rules for foreign filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers requirements and procedures governing handling of inventions subject to national security concerns and foreign filing licenses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 200 - Types and Status of Application; Benefit and Priority Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on application types, status, and claiming benefit or priority to earlier filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains proper form and content of benefit/priority claims and how different application types are treated in prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 300 - Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards relating to ownership of patent rights and assignments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses recordation, transfer of title, and evidence required to establish ownership in prosecution and post-issuance matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 400 - Representative of Applicant or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for recognizing and interacting with patent representatives (agents/attorneys) of applicants or owners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers power of attorney, appointment and withdrawal of counsel, and communication rules between USPTO and representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 500 - Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for receipt, file management, and handling of papers and correspondence submitted to the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains timing, constructive receipt, routing, and processing of submissions; includes handling of filing dates and mail issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 600 - Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the parts, format, and substantive content of patent applications (specification, claims, drawings, abstract).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details statutory and rule-based content requirements (e.g., 35 U.S.C. §112-related items), formatting rules, claim requirements, and examples of acceptable/defective filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 700 - Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and substantive criteria for examination of patent applications by examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers search strategies, allowance and rejection criteria, office actions, interview practice, and examiner responsibilities during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 800 - Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on restriction practice under 35 U.S.C. 111 and on assessing double patenting issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when restriction or election is required, how to handle divisional practice, and analyses for statutory/nonstatutory double patenting rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 900 - Prior Art, Search, Classification, and Routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for prior art searching, classification of applications, and routing within the Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides examiner search expectations, classification rules, and routing/assignment norms to ensure proper prior art consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1000 - Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for matters that are decided at different levels within USPTO (supervisory review, petitions, examiner actions reviewed by officials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains appealability, petition practice, and which officials handle specific disputes or decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1100 - Statutory Invention Registration (SIR); Pre-Grant Publication (PGPub) and Preissuance Submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and effects of statutory invention registration, pre-grant publication, and third-party preissuance submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes timing, content, and legal consequences of publication and preissuance third-party submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1200 - Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures governing appeals from examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board and related appellate practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers appeal initiation, briefs, oral hearings, decisions, and remand procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1300 - Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for allowance of applications and issuance of patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes requirements for notice of allowance, issue fees, certificate of correction, and pre-issuance requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1400 - Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanisms and procedures to correct errors in issued patents (reissue, certificate of correction, disclaimers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains available correction types, standards for reissue, and post-grant correction practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1500 - Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive and procedural guidance specific to design patent applications and their prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers claim/drawing requirements unique to design patents and prosecution differences from utility patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1600 - Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for preparation, examination, and issuance of plant patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes requirements particular to asexual reproduction, specimen deposit, and claim drafting for plant patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1700 - Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Various topics that do not fall neatly into other chapters; catch-all guidance on assorted patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See chapter for a range of procedural and substantive topics referenced across the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1800 - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on international filing under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) and related USPTO procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes national phase entry, PCT international search and examination considerations, and USPTO roles under the PCT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1900 - Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for filing and resolving protests against pending applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains timing, acceptable protest content, and how protests are considered by the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2000 - Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and practitioner/examiner obligations regarding disclosure of information (duty of candor and good faith; IDS practice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes duty to disclose material information, timing and content of information disclosure statements, and sanctions for failure to comply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2100 - Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and guidance on patentability determinations, including novelty, obviousness, statutory subject matter, and enabling disclosure requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers legal standards (e.g., novelty, inventive step/obviousness, subject matter eligibility) and examiner application of those standards during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2200 - Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for citation of prior art and for initiating/processing ex parte reexamination proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how prior art is cited against issued patents and the procedures for reexamination petitions and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2300 - Interference and Derivation Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for determining priority and derivation between competing inventors/applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers interference practice (historical), derivation proceedings under the AIA, and standards for proving derivation or priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2400 - Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized guidance on biotechnology-related inventions and examination considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses patentability, enablement, written description, deposit requirements, and other biotech-specific examination concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2500 - Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and schedules for payment of maintenance fees to keep patents in force.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers due dates, grace periods, fee calculation, and reinstatement where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2600 - Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for optional inter partes reexamination of patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how inter partes reexamination is requested, examined, and concluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2700 - Patent Terms, Adjustments, and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and computations for patent term, term adjustments, and term extensions (including regulatory extensions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides methods to calculate term adjustments, extensions, and handling of term-related disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2800 - Supplemental Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for supplemental examination of issued patents to consider, reconsider, or correct information relevant to patentability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains filing, review, and interplay with inequitable conduct and reexamination processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2900 - International Design Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for filings and procedures related to international design applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers requirements and processing for design applications with international aspects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Reserved
rubrics_metrics.description: Placeholder appendix reserved for future content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currently no substantive content; reserved for future additions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Compilation of decisions cited throughout the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use as a reference to locate cited case law and USPTO decisions referenced in MPEP guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Text or consolidated references to patent statutes relevant to MPEP guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains statutory provisions (consolidated laws as of stated dates) used throughout the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Text or consolidated references to patent rules and regulations relevant to MPEP guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains consolidated rules (as of stated dates) and procedural regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: PCT-related texts and administrative instructions relevant to MPEP's PCT guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference text for PCT procedures and USPTO's implementation guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under the PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative instructions implementing PCT provisions relevant to applicants and USPTO practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains administrative guidance for handling PCT matters at the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Text or references related to the Paris Convention as it pertains to patent practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference for priority and international treaty-related filing considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.description: An index to help locate topics and subject matter within the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to find specific topics, terms, or issues across chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form Paragraphs
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardized form paragraphs for use in office actions and USPTO correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides ready-made paragraph text for common office action statements and procedural communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zipped version of the MPEP current revision (PDF)
rubrics_metrics.description: A compressed downloadable archive of the current MPEP in PDF format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download for offline access; contains full manual PDF files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current fees / Consolidated Laws / Consolidated Rules links
rubrics_metrics.description: Links from the MPEP page to current USPTO fee schedule and consolidated patent laws and rules (as of specific dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these links for fee amounts and the current statutory/regulatory texts that govern practice; MPEP may be superseded by later law or rule changes noted on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subsequent Publications (After January 31, 2024)
rubrics_metrics.description: A listing of documents that made changes to USPTO patent examining policies and procedures after January 31, 2024 and are under consideration for inclusion in a future publication of the MPEP (listing current as of July 18, 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this listing to identify post-MPEP guidance, notices, and rule changes that may affect examination practice before formal incorporation into the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notices that Supersede Portions of the Current MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific notices and revised form paragraphs that supersede one or more portions of the current MPEP (examples listed on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include revised form paragraphs for design patents, fee-setting form paragraphs, and advance notices of changes; consult listed notices for immediate policy changes that override older MPEP text.
